newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: Key Brazilian ports reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soyproducts:
Vessels: Huta Kotowice loading 54,000 tonnes soybeans, due to complete April 8. Hilon of Sparta waiting to dock, to load 55,000 tonnes soybeans.
Road: 214 trucks arrived between April 4 and 6 carrying 5,502 tonnes soybeans while three trucks arrived with 82 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: One wagon arrived with 69 tonnes soybeans and three wagons with 182 tonnes soymeal.
Loading: 16,325 tonnes soybeans loaded, no soymeal.

Vessels: Stjepov loading 27,000 tonnes soymeal. Sea Trader loading 28,000 soymeal. Grigorpan loading 24,580 tonnes soymeal. Johnny C loading 46,000 tonnes soybeans. Allalinhorn loading 28,000 tonnes soymeal. Azija loading loading 36,000 tonnes soyoil. Thirteen vessels waiting to load soymeal, 12 to load soybeans and two mixed cargo (soymeal/corn, soybeans/soymeal).
Road: 3,480 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between April 4 and 6, while 687 arrived with soymeal and 168 with vegetable oils including soyoil.
